title: The Middle Book of the Steel Fist
summary: Builds on the Basic manuals with qi-seated crushing blows and a cuff that turns a block into a counter.

title: Gauntlet Breaking of Guards
summary: Teaches how to pry open a raised guard with steel fingers and burst it with a pulse of qi.

title: Treatise on the Cuff as Shield and Hammer
summary: A treatise on using the steel forearm cuff both to stop heavy blows and to strike back with the same arm.

title: On the Seizing Hand in Armored Combat
summary: Explains grabbing and holding a limb with a steel hand and breaking free when the opponent grabs back.

title: A Soldier's Manual of the Mail Glove
summary: A field manual for fighting in a close rank with a mail-backed glove covering oneself and a comrade's open side.

title: Rhythms of the Heavy Fist
summary: Teaches timing a heavy glove in counted beats and stealing the beat of an opponent's own attack.

title: The Long Reach Primer of Forearm Armor
summary: A primer on stretching the armored arm to its full length to jab sweep and guard at the edge of reach.

title: Counter-Strike Lessons for the Plated Hand
summary: Lessons in answering a parry or a miss with an instant steel counter backed by a measured breath of qi.
